name: MAPA · Ambulance operations
body:
ASR Health operators can open the call intake desk from Create new ambulance call.
Search the ASR district directory and online place results inside MAPA. Place or drag a pickup pin to fill its coordinates and pickup description, then confirm the exact location with the caller.
Follow call progress from saved intake and operator review to crew dispatch and acknowledgement.
Ambulance selection explains existing assignments, crew access, duty status, capability and GPS freshness. MAPA checks eligibility again before dispatch.
An optional caller coordination number is available to the assigned crew.
Documents and time windows are optional when creating an ambulance call.

name: MAPA · Crew and administration
body:
MAPA Crew Android 1.9.0 connects to the ASR Health workspace for assigned calls and device location updates.
MAPA branding is used across sign in, operations, administration, AI settings and these release notes.
Administrator and Super Admin access retain their respective permissions.
DEMO training records stay clearly identified. Telephone provider setup remains required before automatic incoming call capture is available.
